items.q: How many years does medicine take in Ukraine?
items.a: Each university publishes the duration of its own programme, and the wording differs between universities and programmes, so we do not state a general figure. We show the exact wording on the university's profile once it has been read from the official programme page; until then the profile says “to be confirmed”.

items.q: How much does it cost to study medicine in Ukraine?
items.a: Only each university's official fee schedule for the current intake can answer this. We publish a fee only with its academic year, currency, payment basis and the date we read it, and never an estimate or a figure copied from an agency website. See the tuition fees guide for what a schedule includes and excludes.

items.q: Is NEET required to study medicine in Ukraine?
items.a: Whether an applicant from India must pass an eligibility examination before studying medicine abroad is decided by India's medical regulator, not by any Ukrainian university. We do not advise on it and we will summarise the rule only with a link to the regulator's own published document. Check the National Medical Commission's current rules before you apply.

items.q: Is a medical degree from Ukraine valid in India, Germany or Canada?
items.a: Recognition of a foreign medical qualification is decided by the regulator of the country where you intend to practise, under its current rules for foreign medical graduates, and often involves its own examinations. No university, agent or website can grant recognition. We do not publish recognition claims; where we can cite a regulator's own document we will link it.

items.q: Do I need biology and chemistry to apply?
items.a: It depends on the university, the programme, your school-leaving qualification and the intake. Many medical programmes publish subject or entrance-examination requirements that include biology and chemistry, but there is no universal rule, and we only use a requirement once it has been read on the official page. The readiness check compares your subjects and grades with the verified requirements of the programme you choose.

items.q: How do I know a website is the university's official site?
items.a: Most Ukrainian state universities publish on their own domain, and the Ministry of Education's “Study in Ukraine” portal lists each institution with its contacts. Several third-party sites use university names in their addresses. Every published profile here links the university's official domain; check the address before you send anything. Send documents and payments only through the university's own published procedure.
